slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
For similar polygons, write the similarity statement with matching vertices, like ABCD is similar to WXYZ. For a map ABCD to WXYZ with image/preimage scale factor k, use WX/AB=XY/BC=YZ/CD=ZW/DA=k. If using reciprocal ratios, label their common value 1/k. Corresponding angles are equal.

To find a missing side, set up a proportion from two pairs of corresponding sides. If a 4 by 6 photo is enlarged so its short side is 10, the long side is x with 4/10 = 6/x, so x = 15.

Equal angles alone are not enough for polygons with more than three sides: a square and a non-square rectangle have equal angles but are not similar.
